name: Traxettle Knowledgebase
description: Machine-readable mapping from each knowledgebase document to the source files it describes. Used by .devin/skills/traxettle-kb-refresh/scripts/check-staleness.mjs to detect staleness.

criticality.critical: A behavioural contract. If the source changed, the document is probably wrong and someone will act on it.
criticality.high: Detailed reference. Drifts easily; review promptly.
criticality.low: Narrative or conceptual; source churn rarely invalidates it.

01-product/01-glossary.md.note: Every domain term. Any new type, status or policy value belongs here.

01-product/02-capability-matrix.md.note: Supported / in-progress / not-supported. People scope work from this.

01-product/03-user-journeys.md.note: Workflows, state machines and the who-can-do-what table.

01-product/04-money-pooling-functional.m.note: The functional contract of money pooling, including every refusal message.

01-product/05-plans-entitlements-billing.note: Free vs Pro, capabilities, RevenueCat, the gateway pilot.

02-architecture/00-system-architecture.m.note: Components, request flow, runtime config, Firebase backends, build graph.

02-architecture/01-data-model.md.note: Collections, every type, the money representation, and the ledger invariants.

02-architecture/02-api-reference.md.note: Every endpoint, body and error code. The most consequential document to keep fresh.

02-architecture/03-money-pooling-engine..note: The pool maths. A change here without a doc update will mislead someone about money.

02-architecture/04-web-codemap.md.note: Route -> file -> responsibility for the web app, including every pool test id.

02-architecture/05-mobile-codemap.md.note: Screen -> file -> responsibility for the mobile app, plus native config.

02-architecture/07-auth-and-security.md.note: Token ladder, mock-auth rule, access control, Firestore/Storage rules, uploads.

02-architecture/08-realtime.md.note: Rooms and the full socket event catalogue, including pool:updated reasons.

03-operations/00-environments.md.note: Environment matrix, URLs, projects, and the full env-var reference.

03-operations/01-local-development.md.note: The six run modes and every Rush command. Breaks loudly when a script changes.

03-operations/02-staging-verification-gu.note: The exact steps to run web + iOS sim + Android emulator against staging.

03-operations/03-staging-test-scenarios..note: Manual test scenarios with exact expected values and copy.

03-operations/04-build-and-release.md.note: Build profiles, signing, versioning, CI. Contains the production-profile warnings.

03-operations/05-deployment.md.note: Cloud Run deploys, production invariants, rollback.

03-operations/06-testing-and-qa.md.note: What tests exist and how to run them.

04-engineering/00-conventions.md.note: Patterns actually used. Reference files: routes/pools.ts and pool-math.ts.

04-engineering/01-change-playbooks.md.note: "I need to add X" -> files in order. Must track the real file layout.

04-engineering/02-known-issues-and-debt..note: Verified defects and accepted trade-offs. Re-verify each entry when re-pinning.

INDEX.md.note: The question -> document map, plus the fast-facts table.
